## АКБ "Пермь" — Company.id 4517

Catalog metadata (unchanged):

```json
{
  "countryCode": "RU",
  "fullTitle": null,
  "id": 4517,
  "title": "\u0410\u041a\u0411 \"\u041f\u0435\u0440\u043c\u044c\"",
  "url": "bankperm.ru"
}
```

Frozen base commit: `fe29fbc1291b8842ed201261408a3bc690875b55`. Checked: `2026-10-02T21:17:57.620477Z`.

### Exact versions and source

- No existing icon.svg at frozen base commit; this is the first icon addition.
- Fetched source SVG: [source.svg](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/e262cfa6b2df9e0928e74bb11f1a6d97008497ae/review-materials/4517/source.svg) — SHA-256 `047eb84637e413541f4030c4f4b437437776ab1e186db352389ae2b9487be4e0`.

- Source asset: [https://bankperm.ru/static/images/BankPerm-Logo.svg?h=9343761c](https://bankperm.ru/static/images/BankPerm-Logo.svg?h=9343761c).

### Evidence and judgment

- official checked 2026-10-02T21:07:00Z: [https://bankperm.ru/](https://bankperm.ru/); asset [https://bankperm.ru/static/images/BankPerm-Logo.svg?h=9343761c](https://bankperm.ru/static/images/BankPerm-Logo.svg?h=9343761c). Live official site \(title «Бизнесу — Банк Пермь \(АО\)»\); header logo is BankPerm-Logo.svg \(sha256 047eb84637e413541f4030c4f4b437437776ab1e186db352389ae2b9487be4e0, 4297 bytes, viewBox 0 0 252 39, fill #0D47A1, pure paths\). Site also loads Golova\_logo.svg / Golova\_logo\_color.svg — GOLOVA MEDIA partner logos, unrelated and rejected. Lockup rendered via rsvg-convert and inspected: stacked-ellipse БП monogram emblem left \(x≈0–78\), БАНК ПЕРМЬ wordmark right. (independence group: bankperm.ru official site).
- third-party checked 2026-10-02T21:09:00Z: [https://cbr.ru/ bank registry entry for OGRN 1025900000510](https://cbr.ru/%20bank%20registry%20entry%20for%20OGRN%201025900000510). Bank of Russia registry \(fetched via ticketed search, result search-cbr-status.json\) confirms АКБ «Пермь» reg. no. 875, base license issued 2018-11-08, status «Действует», and lists bankperm.ru as the bank's official site. Operating bank; current-design period applies. (independence group: cbr.ru registry).
- Independent evidence: Two independent groups: the bank's own official site \(asset origin\) and the Bank of Russia registry \(identity/status\); the registry is not a mirror of the site asset..
- Identity: confirmed — CBR registry \(OGRN 1025900000510\) and the live official site both identify АКБ «Пермь» \(АО\), brand «Банк Пермь \(АО\)», reg. no. 875; bankperm.ru is the bank's own domain per CBR, so the record represents this operating entity with no successor substitution..
- Currency: confirmed — The logo is the header asset of the bank's live official site fetched 2026-10-02, corroborated by the CBR registry active status on the same date; current design in current use..
- Variant: confirmed — Standalone БП stacked-ellipse monogram emblem from the official header lockup, single color #0D47A1; monogram letters form the mark itself, which catalog suitability allows; the wordmark is excluded by the lossless crop. Rendered preview of the emblem region is complete and unclipped..

Rationale: First addition for АКБ «Пермь»: the official site header logo is an original SVG; its standalone БП stacked-ellipse monogram emblem \(pure paths, #0D47A1\) is a suitable catalog mark — monogram letters form the mark itself, no accompanying name or slogan. Official provenance, current use confirmed 2026-10-02 via the live site and CBR registry..
Role: standalone emblem from the official horizontal lockup; emblem part of BankPerm-Logo.svg; variant: current official variant, single color #0D47A1 on transparent background; transparent standalone mark kept transparent, no backing added.
Visible difference: First addition: the frozen base has no icon.svg for this record, so the change is absence to a real icon — the standalone official emblem..
Details: All path details preserved: stacked arc strokes, ellipse rings and their negative spaces identical to the source render; optimization changed no visible detail.. Proportions: Emblem proportions match the source region exactly \(uniform crop, no scaling distortion\); fits the square cell with clear margins, complete at 24/32/48 px on both themes in the Desktop renders..

Source-to-final transformations:
- Lossless viewBox crop of the original download to the emblem region \(viewBox 0 0 252 39 -\> 0 0 78 39\): selects the standalone emblem, discards the separate BANK PERM wordmark; no path data or fill changed.
- SVGO 4.1.0 with the frozen repository configuration, multipass: 4295 -\> 4251 bytes; trial-produced, selected — smaller and visually faithful \(independent rasterizer comparison of working vs optimized at equal scale\).

![First icon addition — light background](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/e262cfa6b2df9e0928e74bb11f1a6d97008497ae/review-materials/4517/comparison-light.png?raw=true)

### Render checks and limits

Desktop renderer recorded: `offscreen CPU Skia/painterResource` at `2026-10-02T21:16:29.852724761Z`. Final renders \(offscreen CPU Skia/painterResource, 240x240, both themes inspected\) show the complete unclipped emblem, good contrast on #FFFFFF and #121212, no text.

- android-compose: not-tested (available: false) — Android SDK is installed \(build-tools 36.0.0, platform android-37.0\) but no system image, no AVD and no connected device are present; creating an AVD would require downloading a system image, which is outside this run. Risk: Compose Android rendering of the vector XML unverified..
- android-native: not-tested (available: false) — Same limitation as android-compose: no emulator or device available without downloading a system image. Risk: native Android display path unverified..
- ios-compose: not-tested (available: false) — No iOS toolchain in this Linux environment..
- ios-native: not-tested (available: false) — No iOS toolchain in this Linux environment..

Desktop observation is for the generated XML through Compose Desktop `painterResource`, not a claim of successful Android/iOS or native-widget rendering. Unavailable targets remain untested; reviewer visual approval and merge remain separate decisions.
